verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is an operating system that users install and run on their own hardware. The docs say 'your desktop is your own' and 'your data belongs to you', releases.json lists downloadable images, and community users report running it long-term on personal laptops and home servers. missing for 10: explicit first-party install/download documentation in the pack, any AI-native self-hosting specifics (e.g., local model workflows).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: With Fedora, your desktop is your own. It's free, there are no ads, and your data belongs to you.
Has run a home server on Fedora with in-place upgrades since about version 28 with no OS problems.
also runs it on a home media server with Cockpit
